author: Carla
title: Lodging captures nearly half of Miami-Dade visitor spending
detail: $10.4B of $22.7B in 2025. 216,000+ tourism jobs, about 10% of county employment.
whoAffected: Hotels; everyone else competes for the other half
implication: Margin sits with lodging. Experiences and services fight over what's left.

sources.label: GMCVB, June 2026: 216,000+ tourism jobs (about 10% of county employment); lodging is $10.4 billion, nearly half of visitor spending
GMCVB, June 2026: 28.3 million visitors and $22.7 billion in visitor spending in 2025 (+4.1% vs. 2024); $32.2 billion total economic impact
